steps.name: ci-local-jobs
steps.description: Every manifest step runs in exactly one CI job (scripts/check-ci-local-jobs.mjs)

steps.name: release-pipeline
steps.description: The tag workflow promotes the image its own checked SHA published

steps.name: release-contract
steps.description: npm run release:check (tag workflows export RELEASE_CONTRACT_TAG)

steps.name: static-check
steps.run: find static -type f -name '*.js' ! -path 'static/vendor/*' ! -name 'mermaid.min.js' -exec node --check {} \; && npm run i18n:check

steps.name: audit-lockfiles
steps.description: RustSec audit of Cargo.lock and npm audit of package-lock.json

ignore.reason: rsa Marvin timing side channel, no fixed release; reachable only through public-key OIDC/JWT/WebAuthn verification; klaxond performs no RSA private-key operation (enforced by rsa-guard, docs/security-rsa-risk.md)

crypto-bigint 0.5 timing variability, reachable only through elliptic-curve 0.13 public-key verification (auth-modules jsonwebtoken/openidconnect -> p256/p384, webauthn-rs -> crypto-glue); klaxond performs no EC private-key operation (enforced by rsa-guard); the 0.7.6 fix needs elliptic-curve 0.14, which no jsonwebtoken release uses yet (docs/security/rustsec-policy.md)

steps.name: rust-clippy
steps.description: clippy, whole workspace, all targets and features, warnings denied

steps.name: rust-test-postgres
steps.description: PostgreSQL persistence tests (the ignored suite) against a real database

steps.name: npm-install
steps.description: Clean install of the root lockfile (Playwright, Redocly)

steps.name: openapi-lint
steps.description: Redocly lint of docs/openapi.yaml (npm run openapi:lint)

steps.name: e2e
steps.description: Playwright browser workflows: Chromium, Firefox, WebKit and Mobile Safari (npm run test:e2e)
